sources.author: MightyMich
patch_list: Choose a blue/red/gold launcher icon, or pick a PNG from your phone.
Soft-bypasses client gates that block local chat backup when Google Drive / Play Services appear missing. Prefer offline Databases folder.
Sets android:allowBackup=true so the package can participate in device backup agents (Seedvault / adb). Does not implement Drive.
Show messages that were deleted for everyone. Client-side only; already-wiped history cannot be restored.
Treats Google Play Services checks as successful so WhatsApp works better with microG. Does not replace microG itself.
Placeholder: adds the MightyMich strings but does not inject a Settings row yet. Disabled by default so it cannot be mistaken for a working UI patch.
Adds English strings for the planned MightyMich section in WhatsApp Settings.
Blocks outgoing read receipts (blue ticks). Local read state is kept.
Hides Meta AI on the chats home screen (FAB / pill), related hub entry points, and common feature gates. Does not delete existing Meta AI chats.
If enabled, others won't see when you are typing.
Disables Falco analytics event logging and uploads. Leaves crash reporting and core WAM/registration telemetry alone.
Allow reopening and saving view once photos and videos.
